title: Penerbangan dari CSV (SELECT)
code:
REPORT z_flights.

* Tables come from CSV files in the db/ folder:
*   db/zflight.csv and db/zcarrier.csv
DATA lv_city TYPE string VALUE 'JAKARTA'.

SELECT carrid, connid, cityto, price, seatsmax, seatsocc
  FROM zflight
  WHERE cityfrom = @lv_city
  ORDER BY price DESCENDING
  INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

WRITE / |Penerbangan dari { lv_city }: { sy-dbcnt } ditemukan|.
cl_demo_output=>display( lt_flights ).

* Classic SELECT ... ENDSELECT loop, typed with the table itself
DATA ls_flight TYPE zflight.
WRITE / 'Penerbangan hampir penuh:'.
SELECT * FROM zflight INTO ls_flight WHERE seatsocc > 160.
  DATA(lv_load) = ls_flight-seatsocc * 100 / ls_flight-seatsmax.
  WRITE: / ls_flight-carrid, ls_flight-connid, |{ ls_flight-cityfrom } -> { ls_flight-cityto }|, |{ lv_load }%|.
ENDSELECT.

SELECT SINGLE carrname FROM zcarrier WHERE carrid = 'GA' INTO @DATA(lv_carrname).
IF sy-subrc = 0.
  WRITE / |GA adalah { lv_carrname }|.
ENDIF.

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, AVG( price ) AS avg_price, MAX( price ) AS max_price
  FROM zflight
  INTO @DATA(ls_stats).
WRITE / |{ ls_stats-cnt } penerbangan, rata-rata harga { round( val = ls_stats-avg_price dec = 0 ) }, termahal { ls_stats-max_price }|.

SELECT * FROM zcarrier WHERE carrname LIKE '%Air%' INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_air).
WRITE / |Maskapai dengan kata 'Air': { lines( lt_air ) }|.

title: Kelas, interface & exception
code:
REPORT z_bank_accounts.

* Local classes, interfaces, inheritance and class-based exceptions

INTERFACE lif_printable.
  METHODS describe RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS lcx_insufficient_funds DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_needed TYPE p DECIMALS 2 READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_needed TYPE p OPTIONAL.
    METHODS get_text REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcx_insufficient_funds IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    super->constructor( ).
    mv_needed = iv_needed.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_text.
    result = |Saldo tidak cukup, kurang Rp { mv_needed }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_account DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_amount TYPE p LENGTH 15 DECIMALS 2.
    INTERFACES lif_printable.
    CLASS-DATA gv_count TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_owner TYPE string iv_balance TYPE p OPTIONAL.
    METHODS deposit IMPORTING iv_amount TYPE p.
    METHODS withdraw IMPORTING iv_amount TYPE p RAISING lcx_insufficient_funds.
    METHODS get_balance RETURNING VALUE(rv_balance) TYPE ty_amount.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mv_owner TYPE string.
    DATA mv_balance TYPE ty_amount.
    METHODS kind RETURNING VALUE(rv_kind) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_account IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_owner = iv_owner.
    mv_balance = iv_balance.
    gv_count = gv_count + 1.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD deposit.
    mv_balance = mv_balance + iv_amount.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD withdraw.
    IF iv_amount > mv_balance.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE lcx_insufficient_funds
        EXPORTING iv_needed = iv_amount - mv_balance.
    ENDIF.
    mv_balance = mv_balance - iv_amount.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_balance.
    rv_balance = mv_balance.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD kind.
    rv_kind = 'Tabungan'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD lif_printable~describe.
    rv_text = |{ kind( ) } { mv_owner }: Rp { mv_balance }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_savings DEFINITION INHERITING FROM lcl_account.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_interest IMPORTING iv_percent TYPE p.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS kind REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_savings IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_interest.
    deposit( mv_balance * iv_percent / 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD kind.
    rv_kind = 'Deposito'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

START-OF-SELECTION.
  DATA lt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO lif_printable WITH EMPTY KEY.

  DATA(lo_andi) = NEW lcl_account( iv_owner = `Andi` iv_balance = 500000 ).
  DATA(lo_sari) = NEW lcl_savings( iv_owner = `Sari` iv_balance = 2000000 ).

  lo_andi->deposit( 250000 ).
  lo_sari->add_interest( '2.5' ).

  TRY.
      lo_andi->withdraw( 1000000 ).
    CATCH lcx_insufficient_funds INTO DATA(lx_funds).
      WRITE / |Gagal tarik tunai: { lx_funds->get_text( ) }|.
  ENDTRY.

  " Runtime errors are exceptions too
  TRY.
      DATA(lv_ratio) = lo_andi->get_balance( ) / 0.
    CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zero).
      WRITE / |Ditangkap: { lx_zero->get_text( ) }|.
  ENDTRY.

  APPEND lo_andi TO lt_items.
  APPEND lo_sari TO lt_items.
  LOOP AT lt_items INTO DATA(lo_item).
    WRITE / lo_item->describe( ).
  ENDLOOP.

  DATA(lv_level) = COND string( WHEN lo_sari->get_balance( ) > 1000000 THEN `prioritas`
                                ELSE `reguler` ).
  WRITE / |Jumlah rekening: { lcl_account=>gv_count }, status Sari: { lv_level }|.

title: SQL lanjutan: JOIN, GROUP BY, COMMIT
code:
REPORT z_sql_lanjutan.

* JOIN, GROUP BY, field-symbol, lalu menulis ke tabel dengan COMMIT WORK

SELECT c~carrname, COUNT(*) AS penerbangan, SUM( f~seatsocc ) AS penumpang
  FROM zflight AS f
  INNER JOIN zcarrier AS c ON f~carrid = c~carrid
  GROUP BY c~carrname
  ORDER BY penumpang DESCENDING
  INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_rekap).

cl_demo_output=>display( data = lt_rekap name = `Rekap per maskapai` ).

" Field-symbol: ubah harga langsung di internal table, tanpa MODIFY
SELECT * FROM zflight WHERE carrid = 'JT' INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_jt).
LOOP AT lt_jt ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_flight>).
  <ls_flight>-price = <ls_flight>-price * 110 / 100.
ENDLOOP.

DATA(lv_total) = REDUCE zflight-price( INIT s = 0 FOR ls IN lt_jt NEXT s = s + ls-price ).
WRITE / |Harga Lion Air setelah naik 10%, total: { lv_total }|.

" Tulis kembali ke database
MODIFY zflight FROM TABLE lt_jt.
COMMIT WORK.
WRITE / |{ sy-dbcnt } baris zflight diperbarui (lihat tab Tabel)|.

title: ALV grid (cl_salv_table)
code:
REPORT z_alv.

* ALV grid with CL_SALV_TABLE: column texts, sorting and totals
SELECT f~carrid, c~carrname, f~connid, f~cityfrom, f~cityto, f~price, f~seatsocc
  FROM zflight AS f
  INNER JOIN zcarrier AS c ON f~carrid = c~carrid
  INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

TRY.
    cl_salv_table=>factory(
      IMPORTING r_salv_table = DATA(lo_alv)
      CHANGING  t_table      = lt_flights ).

    lo_alv->get_display_settings( )->set_list_header( 'Penerbangan per maskapai' ).
    lo_alv->get_display_settings( )->set_striped_pattern( abap_true ).
    lo_alv->get_functions( )->set_all( abap_true ).

    DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv->get_columns( ).
    lo_columns->set_optimize( abap_true ).
    lo_columns->get_column( 'CARRNAME' )->set_long_text( 'Maskapai' ).
    lo_columns->get_column( 'CITYFROM' )->set_long_text( 'Dari' ).
    lo_columns->get_column( 'CITYTO' )->set_long_text( 'Ke' ).
    lo_columns->get_column( 'PRICE' )->set_long_text( 'Harga' ).
    lo_columns->get_column( 'SEATSOCC' )->set_long_text( 'Penumpang' ).
    lo_columns->get_column( 'CARRID' )->set_technical( abap_true ).

    lo_alv->get_sorts( )->add_sort( columnname = 'CARRNAME' ).
    lo_alv->get_sorts( )->add_sort( columnname = 'PRICE' sequence = if_salv_c_sort=>sort_down ).
    lo_alv->get_aggregations( )->add_aggregation( 'SEATSOCC' ).

    lo_alv->display( ).
  CATCH cx_salv_msg cx_salv_not_found cx_salv_existing INTO DATA(lx_salv).
    WRITE / lx_salv->get_text( ).
ENDTRY.

title: ALV interaktif (klik & event)
code:
REPORT z_alv_interaktif.

* ALV interaktif: klik dua kali sebuah baris, klik link di kolom Maskapai,
* atau tombol "Hampir penuh" di toolbar. Handler event (SET HANDLER) lalu
* menampilkan detail penerbangan.
CLASS lcl_handler DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    METHODS on_double_click FOR EVENT double_click OF cl_salv_events_table
      IMPORTING row column.
    METHODS on_link_click FOR EVENT link_click OF cl_salv_events_table
      IMPORTING row column.
    METHODS on_function FOR EVENT added_function OF cl_salv_events_table
      IMPORTING e_salv_function.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = CORRESPONDING #( it_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_double_click.
    DATA(ls_flight) = mt_flights[ row ].
    DATA(lv_pct) = ls_flight-seatsocc * 100 / ls_flight-seatsmax.
    WRITE: / |Baris { row }, kolom { to_lower( column ) }:|,
           / |{ ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } { ls_flight-cityfrom } → { ls_flight-cityto }|,
           / |Terisi { ls_flight-seatsocc } dari { ls_flight-seatsmax } kursi ({ lv_pct }%)|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_link_click.
    DATA(lv_carrid) = mt_flights[ row ]-carrid.
    SELECT connid, cityfrom, cityto, price FROM zflight
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid
      ORDER BY price
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_rute).
    cl_salv_table=>factory( IMPORTING r_salv_table = DATA(lo_popup) CHANGING t_table = lt_rute ).
    lo_popup->get_display_settings( )->set_list_header( |Semua rute { lv_carrid }| ).
    lo_popup->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_function.
    CASE e_salv_function.
      WHEN 'ZPENUH'.
        WRITE / 'Penerbangan yang terisi 90% atau lebih:'.
        LOOP AT mt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
          IF ls_flight-seatsocc * 100 >= ls_flight-seatsmax * 90.
            WRITE / |  { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } { ls_flight-seatsocc }/{ ls_flight-seatsmax }|.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

START-OF-SELECTION.
  SELECT * FROM zflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

  cl_salv_table=>factory( IMPORTING r_salv_table = DATA(lo_alv) CHANGING t_table = lt_flights ).
  lo_alv->get_display_settings( )->set_list_header( 'Klik dua kali sebuah baris' ).
  lo_alv->get_functions( )->set_all( abap_true ).
  lo_alv->get_functions( )->add_function(
    name     = 'ZPENUH'
    icon     = '@3W@'
    text     = 'Hampir penuh'
    tooltip  = 'Penerbangan yang terisi 90% atau lebih'
    position = if_salv_c_function_position=>right_of_salv_functions ).

  DATA lo_col TYPE REF TO cl_salv_column_table.
  lo_col ?= lo_alv->get_columns( )->get_column( 'CARRID' ).
  lo_col->set_cell_type( if_salv_c_cell_type=>hotspot ).
  lo_col->set_long_text( 'Maskapai' ).

  DATA(lo_handler) = NEW lcl_handler( lt_flights ).
  DATA(lo_events) = lo_alv->get_event( ).
  SET HANDLER lo_handler->on_double_click FOR lo_events.
  SET HANDLER lo_handler->on_link_click FOR lo_events.
  SET HANDLER lo_handler->on_function FOR lo_events.

  lo_alv->display( ).

title: Event kelas & data reference
code:
REPORT z_event_referensi.

* Event kelas (EVENTS, RAISE EVENT, SET HANDLER) dan data reference (REF #, ->*)
INTERFACE lif_saldo.
  EVENTS menipis EXPORTING VALUE(sisa) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS lcl_rekening DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES lif_saldo.
    EVENTS ditarik EXPORTING VALUE(jumlah) TYPE i VALUE(catatan) TYPE string DEFAULT `-`.
    CLASS-EVENTS dibuat.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_saldo TYPE i.
    METHODS tarik IMPORTING iv TYPE i.
    DATA mv_saldo TYPE i READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_rekening IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_saldo = iv_saldo.
    RAISE EVENT dibuat.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD tarik.
    mv_saldo = mv_saldo - iv.
    RAISE EVENT ditarik EXPORTING jumlah = iv.
    IF mv_saldo < 100.
      RAISE EVENT lif_saldo~menipis EXPORTING sisa = mv_saldo.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_log DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS on_tarik FOR EVENT ditarik OF lcl_rekening IMPORTING jumlah catatan sender.
    METHODS on_menipis FOR EVENT menipis OF lif_saldo IMPORTING sisa.
    CLASS-METHODS on_dibuat FOR EVENT dibuat OF lcl_rekening.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD on_tarik.
    DATA lo TYPE REF TO lcl_rekening.
    lo ?= sender.
    WRITE / |Ditarik { jumlah } ({ catatan }), sisa { lo->mv_saldo }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD on_menipis.
    WRITE / |Peringatan: saldo tinggal { sisa }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD on_dibuat.
    WRITE / 'Rekening dibuat'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

START-OF-SELECTION.
  SET HANDLER lcl_log=>on_dibuat.
  DATA(lo_a) = NEW lcl_rekening( 500 ).
  DATA(lo_b) = NEW lcl_rekening( 500 ).
  DATA(lo_log) = NEW lcl_log( ).
  SET HANDLER lo_log->on_tarik FOR lo_a.
  SET HANDLER lo_log->on_menipis FOR ALL INSTANCES.
  lo_a->tarik( 200 ).
  lo_b->tarik( 450 ).

  " Data reference: REF #( ) menunjuk ke variabel, ->* membaca dan mengubahnya
  DATA lv_bonus TYPE i VALUE 100.
  DATA(lr_bonus) = REF #( lv_bonus ).
  lr_bonus->* = lr_bonus->* * 2.
  WRITE / |Bonus sekarang { lv_bonus }|.

  " LOOP ... REFERENCE INTO mengubah baris tabel langsung
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item, nama TYPE string, harga TYPE i, END OF ty_item.
  DATA lt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY
    WITH NON-UNIQUE SORTED KEY by_harga COMPONENTS harga.
  lt_item = VALUE #( ( nama = `Kopi` harga = 25000 ) ( nama = `Teh` harga = 15000 ) ( nama = `Roti` harga = 20000 ) ).
  LOOP AT lt_item REFERENCE INTO DATA(lr_item).
    lr_item->harga = lr_item->harga * 110 / 100.
  ENDLOOP.
  WRITE / 'Termurah dulu (USING KEY by_harga):'.
  LOOP AT lt_item INTO DATA(ls_item) USING KEY by_harga.
    WRITE: / ls_item-nama, ls_item-harga.
  ENDLOOP.

title: Function module, BAPI & CDS
code:
REPORT z_fungsi_bapi_cds.
* Function module buatan sendiri, BAPI tiruan, view CDS,
* format string template dan MESSAGE dengan message class.

FUNCTION z_hitung_diskon
  IMPORTING iv_harga  TYPE p
            iv_persen TYPE i DEFAULT 10
  EXPORTING ev_bayar  TYPE p
  EXCEPTIONS persen_salah.
  IF iv_persen < 0 OR iv_persen > 100.
    RAISE persen_salah.
  ENDIF.
  ev_bayar = iv_harga - iv_harga * iv_persen / 100.
ENDFUNCTION.

START-OF-SELECTION.
  DATA lv_harga TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 2 VALUE '1250000.50'.
  DATA lv_bayar TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 2.

  WRITE / '--- Function module ---'.
  CALL FUNCTION 'Z_HITUNG_DISKON'
    EXPORTING  iv_harga  = lv_harga
    IMPORTING  ev_bayar  = lv_bayar.
  WRITE / |Harga setelah diskon 10%: Rp { lv_bayar NUMBER = USER }|.

  CALL FUNCTION 'Z_HITUNG_DISKON'
    EXPORTING  iv_harga  = 100
               iv_persen = 150
    IMPORTING  ev_bayar  = lv_bayar
    EXCEPTIONS persen_salah = 1
               OTHERS       = 2.
  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    WRITE / |Persen 150 ditolak, sy-subrc = { sy-subrc }|.
  ENDIF.

  WRITE / '--- Konversi ALPHA ---'.
  DATA lv_matnr TYPE c LENGTH 10.
  CALL FUNCTION 'CONVERSION_EXIT_ALPHA_INPUT'
    EXPORTING input  = '4711'
    IMPORTING output = lv_matnr.
  WRITE / |'4711' menjadi '{ lv_matnr }', { lv_matnr ALPHA = OUT } kalau dibuang nolnya|.

  WRITE / '--- BAPI ---'.
  DATA lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF bapisfldat WITH EMPTY KEY.
  DATA lt_return  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF bapiret2 WITH EMPTY KEY.
  CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_FLIGHT_GETLIST'
    EXPORTING airline     = 'GA'
    TABLES    flight_list = lt_flights
              return      = lt_return.
  LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
    WRITE / |{ ls_flight-airlineid } { ls_flight-connectid } { ls_flight-flightdate DATE = USER } ke { ls_flight-cityto }|.
  ENDLOOP.
  WRITE / lt_return[ 1 ]-message.

  WRITE / '--- View CDS ---'.
  SELECT * FROM zi_rekap_maskapai ORDER BY penumpang DESCENDING INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_rekap).
  LOOP AT lt_rekap INTO DATA(ls_rekap).
    WRITE / |{ ls_rekap-namamaskapai WIDTH = 20 }{ ls_rekap-penerbangan WIDTH = 4 ALIGN = RIGHT } penerbangan{ ls_rekap-penumpang WIDTH = 6 ALIGN = RIGHT } penumpang|.
  ENDLOOP.

  WRITE / '--- MESSAGE ---'.
  MESSAGE e001(znusa) WITH 'XX' '0001' INTO DATA(lv_pesan).
  WRITE / |{ sy-msgty }{ sy-msgno }: { lv_pesan }|.
  MESSAGE s003(znusa).

title: Layar seleksi & AT NEW / SUM
code:
REPORT z_layar_seleksi.
* Layar seleksi: di playground, F8 menampilkan form ini dulu.
* Komentar " di baris PARAMETERS / SELECT-OPTIONS jadi label field-nya.

TABLES zflight.
SELECTION-SCREEN BEGIN OF BLOCK b1 WITH FRAME.            " Filter penerbangan
  SELECT-OPTIONS s_carr FOR zflight-carrid.              " Maskapai
  SELECT-OPTIONS s_date FOR zflight-fldate.              " Tanggal terbang
  PARAMETERS p_min TYPE i DEFAULT 0.                    " Penumpang minimal
SELECTION-SCREEN END OF BLOCK b1.
PARAMETERS p_total AS CHECKBOX DEFAULT 'X'.             " Tampilkan subtotal
PARAMETERS: p_rute  RADIOBUTTON GROUP urut,             " Urut per rute
            p_harga RADIOBUTTON GROUP urut.             " Urut per harga

AT SELECTION-SCREEN.
  IF p_min < 0.
    MESSAGE 'Penumpang minimal tidak boleh negatif' TYPE 'E'.
  ENDIF.

START-OF-SELECTION.
  SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto, price, seatsocc
    FROM zflight
    WHERE carrid IN @s_carr
      AND fldate IN @s_date
      AND seatsocc >= @p_min
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flight).

  IF lt_flight IS INITIAL.
    WRITE / 'Tidak ada penerbangan yang cocok.'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  IF p_harga = abap_true.
    SORT lt_flight BY carrid price DESCENDING.
  ELSE.
    SORT lt_flight BY carrid connid.
  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT lt_flight INTO DATA(ls_flight).
    AT FIRST.
      WRITE / |Penerbangan { lines( lt_flight ) } baris|.
      ULINE.
    ENDAT.
    AT NEW carrid.
      WRITE / |Maskapai { ls_flight-carrid }|.
    ENDAT.
    WRITE / |  { ls_flight-connid } { ls_flight-cityfrom WIDTH = 10 } → { ls_flight-cityto WIDTH = 10 }| &&
            | { ls_flight-price NUMBER = USER WIDTH = 14 ALIGN = RIGHT } { ls_flight-seatsocc WIDTH = 4 ALIGN = RIGHT } pnp|.
    AT END OF carrid.
      IF p_total = abap_true.
        SUM.
        WRITE / |  Subtotal { ls_flight-carrid }: { ls_flight-seatsocc } penumpang|.
      ENDIF.
    ENDAT.
    AT LAST.
      SUM.
      ULINE.
      WRITE / |Total semua: { ls_flight-seatsocc } penumpang|.
    ENDAT.
  ENDLOOP.

title: RAP: READ / MODIFY ENTITIES
code:
REPORT z_rap_eml.
* RAP tanpa server: view CDS zr_penerbangan (tab Tabel) dipakai sebagai
* entity managed. READ / MODIFY ENTITIES bekerja di buffer transaksi;
* datanya baru tersimpan setelah COMMIT ENTITIES.

START-OF-SELECTION.
  " 1. Baca dua penerbangan, satu di antaranya tidak ada
  READ ENTITIES OF zr_penerbangan
    ENTITY penerbangan
    FIELDS ( dari ke terisi kapasitas ) WITH VALUE #(
      ( maskapai = 'GA' nomor = '0401' tanggal = '20261102' )
      ( maskapai = 'GA' nomor = '9999' tanggal = '20261102' ) )
    RESULT DATA(lt_flight)
    FAILED DATA(ls_failed)
    REPORTED DATA(ls_reported).

  LOOP AT lt_flight INTO DATA(ls_flight).
    WRITE / |{ ls_flight-maskapai } { ls_flight-nomor }: { ls_flight-dari } → { ls_flight-ke }, | &&
            |{ ls_flight-terisi }/{ ls_flight-kapasitas } kursi|.
  ENDLOOP.
  LOOP AT ls_reported-penerbangan INTO DATA(ls_msg).
    WRITE / |Gagal ({ ls_failed-penerbangan[ 1 ]-%fail-cause }): { ls_msg-%msg->if_message~get_text( ) }|.
  ENDLOOP.

  " 2. Tambah 5 penumpang dan buat penerbangan baru
  MODIFY ENTITIES OF zr_penerbangan
    ENTITY penerbangan
      UPDATE FIELDS ( terisi )
        WITH VALUE #( ( maskapai = 'GA' nomor = '0401' tanggal = '20261102'
                        terisi = lt_flight[ 1 ]-terisi + 5 ) )
      CREATE FIELDS ( maskapai nomor tanggal dari ke harga kapasitas terisi )
        WITH VALUE #( ( %cid = 'BARU1' maskapai = 'QZ' nomor = '7510' tanggal = '20261201'
                        dari = 'JAKARTA' ke = 'SINGAPURA' harga = '990000' kapasitas = 180 terisi = 0 ) )
    MAPPED DATA(ls_mapped)
    FAILED DATA(ls_failed2).

  IF ls_failed2 IS INITIAL.
    COMMIT ENTITIES.
    WRITE / |Tersimpan. Penerbangan baru: { ls_mapped-penerbangan[ 1 ]-maskapai } { ls_mapped-penerbangan[ 1 ]-nomor } (%cid { ls_mapped-penerbangan[ 1 ]-%cid })|.
  ELSE.
    ROLLBACK ENTITIES.
    WRITE / 'Ada yang gagal, semua perubahan dibatalkan.'.
  ENDIF.

  " 3. Buat lagi dengan key yang sama: gagal karena sudah ada
  MODIFY ENTITIES OF zr_penerbangan
    ENTITY penerbangan
      CREATE FIELDS ( maskapai nomor tanggal ke ) WITH VALUE #(
        ( %cid = 'BARU2' maskapai = 'QZ' nomor = '7510' tanggal = '20261201' ke = 'SINGAPURA' ) )
    FAILED DATA(ls_failed3)
    REPORTED DATA(ls_reported3).
  WRITE / |Coba lagi: { ls_failed3-penerbangan[ 1 ]-%fail-cause } — { ls_reported3-penerbangan[ 1 ]-%msg->if_message~get_text( ) }|.
  ROLLBACK ENTITIES.

  SELECT maskapai, nomor, ke, terisi FROM zr_penerbangan
    WHERE maskapai = 'QZ' OR nomor = '0401'
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_check).
  cl_demo_output=>display( lt_check ).

title: RAP: behavior definition
code:
REPORT z_rap_behavior.
* Behavior definition zr_penerbangan.bdef dan behavior pool zbp_r_penerbangan
* ada di tab Tabel. Program ini hanya konsumen: logika bisnisnya (determination,
* validation, action) berjalan otomatis seperti di sistem SAP.

START-OF-SELECTION.
  " 1. CREATE tanpa kapasitas: determination isiKapasitas mengisi 180
  MODIFY ENTITIES OF zr_penerbangan
    ENTITY penerbangan
      CREATE FIELDS ( maskapai nomor tanggal dari ke harga )
        WITH VALUE #( ( %cid = 'B1' maskapai = 'QZ' nomor = '7510' tanggal = '20261201'
                        dari = 'JAKARTA' ke = 'SINGAPURA' harga = '990000' ) )
    FAILED DATA(ls_failed).
  COMMIT ENTITIES.
  SELECT SINGLE seatsmax FROM zflight WHERE carrid = 'QZ' AND connid = '7510' INTO @DATA(lv_max).
  WRITE / |1. Penerbangan QZ 7510 dibuat, kapasitas otomatis { lv_max } kursi|.

  " 2. Field mandatory: tujuan (Ke) wajib diisi
  MODIFY ENTITIES OF zr_penerbangan
    ENTITY penerbangan
      CREATE FIELDS ( maskapai nomor tanggal )
        WITH VALUE #( ( %cid = 'B2' maskapai = 'QZ' nomor = '7511' tanggal = '20261201' ) )
    FAILED ls_failed
    REPORTED DATA(ls_reported).
  WRITE / |2. { ls_reported-penerbangan[ 1 ]-%msg->if_message~get_text( ) }|.
  ROLLBACK ENTITIES.

  " 3. Validation cekKursi saat COMMIT: 200 penumpang > 180 kursi ditolak
  MODIFY ENTITIES OF zr_penerbangan
    ENTITY penerbangan
      UPDATE FIELDS ( terisi )
        WITH VALUE #( ( maskapai = 'QZ' nomor = '7510' tanggal = '20261201' terisi = 200 ) ).
  COMMIT ENTITIES RESPONSE OF zr_penerbangan
    REPORTED DATA(ls_commit_reported).
  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    WRITE / |3. Commit ditolak: { ls_commit_reported-penerbangan[ 1 ]-%msg->if_message~get_text( ) }|.
    ROLLBACK ENTITIES.
  ENDIF.

  " 4. UPDATE biasa tetap boleh (key-nya readonly : update, jadi tidak ikut berubah)
  MODIFY ENTITIES OF zr_penerbangan
    ENTITY penerbangan
      UPDATE FIELDS ( dari )
        WITH VALUE #( ( maskapai = 'QZ' nomor = '7510' tanggal = '20261201' dari = 'BANDUNG' ) )
    FAILED ls_failed.
  WRITE / |4. Update kota asal: { COND #( WHEN ls_failed IS INITIAL THEN `berhasil` ELSE `gagal` ) }|.
  COMMIT ENTITIES.

  " 5. Action tandaiPenuh: hasilnya baris entity lewat %param
  MODIFY ENTITIES OF zr_penerbangan
    ENTITY penerbangan
      EXECUTE tandaipenuh FROM VALUE #( ( maskapai = 'QZ' nomor = '7510' tanggal = '20261201' ) )
    RESULT DATA(lt_result).
  COMMIT ENTITIES.
  WRITE / |5. Setelah tandaiPenuh: { lt_result[ 1 ]-%param-terisi }/{ lt_result[ 1 ]-%param-kapasitas } kursi, dari { lt_result[ 1 ]-%param-dari }|.

  " 6. Bersihkan lagi
  MODIFY ENTITIES OF zr_penerbangan
    ENTITY penerbangan
      DELETE FROM VALUE #( ( maskapai = 'QZ' nomor = '7510' tanggal = '20261201' ) ).
  COMMIT ENTITIES.
  SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zflight WHERE carrid = 'QZ' INTO @DATA(lv_count).
  WRITE / |6. Dihapus, sisa penerbangan QZ: { lv_count }|.

title: RAP: composition, feature control & classrun
code:
* Kelas console (if_oo_adt_classrun) seperti di ADT: tanpa START-OF-SELECTION,
* F8 menjalankan method main dan out->write( ) mencetak hasilnya.
* RAP: composition travel -> booking, instance feature control, action dengan
* parameter (abstract entity za_diskon) dan cascade delete.
* Tabel, CDS, behavior definition & behavior pool ada di tab Tabel.
CLASS zcl_demo_travel DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_demo_travel IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    out->write( |1. Anak lewat asosiasi (READ BY \\_booking)| ).
    READ ENTITIES OF zr_travel
      ENTITY travel BY \_booking ALL FIELDS WITH VALUE #( ( travelid = '00000001' ) )
      RESULT DATA(lt_book).
    out->write( lt_book ).

    " 2. Booking baru untuk travel 1 lewat CREATE BY association
    MODIFY ENTITIES OF zr_travel
      ENTITY travel CREATE BY \_booking
        FIELDS ( bookingid flight cost ) WITH VALUE #(
          ( travelid = '00000001'
            %target  = VALUE #( ( %cid = 'B3' bookingid = '0003' flight = 'QG 0702' cost = '980000' ) ) ) )
      MAPPED DATA(ls_mapped).
    out->write( |2. Booking baru: { ls_mapped-booking[ 1 ]-travelid }/{ ls_mapped-booking[ 1 ]-bookingid }| ).

    " 3. Action dengan parameter; travel 2 (status X) dimatikan oleh feature control
    MODIFY ENTITIES OF zr_travel
      ENTITY travel EXECUTE diskon FROM VALUE #(
        ( travelid = '00000001' %param-persen = 10 )
        ( travelid = '00000002' %param-persen = 10 ) )
      RESULT DATA(lt_res) FAILED DATA(ls_failed).
    out->write( |3. Harga travel 1 setelah diskon 10%: { lt_res[ 1 ]-%param-price }| ).
    out->write( |   Travel { ls_failed-travel[ 1 ]-travelid } ditolak: { ls_failed-travel[ 1 ]-%fail-cause }| ).

    " 4. DELETE: travel 2 ditolak, travel 1 terhapus beserta booking-nya
    MODIFY ENTITIES OF zr_travel
      ENTITY travel DELETE FROM VALUE #( ( travelid = '00000001' ) ( travelid = '00000002' ) )
      FAILED ls_failed.
    COMMIT ENTITIES.
    SELECT * FROM zbooking INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sisa).
    out->write( |4. Hapus ditolak untuk { lines( ls_failed-travel ) } travel; sisa booking:| ).
    out->write( lt_sisa ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

title: List interaktif (HIDE & AT LINE-SELECTION)
code:
REPORT z_list_interaktif.
* List klasik interaktif: TOP-OF-PAGE, HIDE dan AT LINE-SELECTION.
* Di playground, klik dua kali sebuah baris untuk membuka detailnya;
* tombol Kembali (F3) kembali ke list sebelumnya.

DATA gs_flight TYPE zflight.

TOP-OF-PAGE.
  WRITE: / 'Penerbangan', 25 'Rute'.
  ULINE.

TOP-OF-PAGE DURING LINE-SELECTION.
  WRITE: / |Detail penerbangan (list ke-{ sy-lsind })|.
  ULINE.

START-OF-SELECTION.
  SELECT * FROM zflight ORDER BY carrid, connid INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flight).
  LOOP AT lt_flight INTO gs_flight.
    WRITE: / gs_flight-carrid, gs_flight-connid, 25 gs_flight-cityfrom, '→', gs_flight-cityto.
    HIDE: gs_flight-carrid, gs_flight-connid.
  ENDLOOP.
  CLEAR gs_flight. " baris tanpa HIDE (judul) tidak membawa data penerbangan terakhir

AT LINE-SELECTION.
  IF sy-lsind = 1.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM zflight
      WHERE carrid = @gs_flight-carrid AND connid = @gs_flight-connid
      INTO @DATA(ls_detail).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      WRITE / 'Pilih baris penerbangan, bukan judulnya.'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    WRITE: / 'Maskapai :', ls_detail-carrid,
           / 'Nomor    :', ls_detail-connid,
           / 'Tanggal  :', ls_detail-fldate,
           / 'Harga    :', ls_detail-price,
           / 'Terisi   :', ls_detail-seatsocc, 'dari', ls_detail-seatsmax.
    SKIP.
    WRITE / 'Klik dua kali baris Terisi untuk melihat persentasenya.'.
    HIDE gs_flight-carrid.
  ELSE.
    WRITE / |Baris yang dipilih: { condense( sy-lisel ) }|.
  ENDIF.

title: ABAP modern: SQL CASE/UNION/WITH & GROUP BY
code:
REPORT z_sql_itab_modern.
* ABAP modern: SQL dengan CASE, fungsi, subquery, UNION dan WITH,
* lalu internal table dengan GROUP BY, FOR GROUPS dan FILTER.

* 1. Ekspresi di daftar kolom: CASE, aritmetika, fungsi SQL, CAST
SELECT FROM zflight
  FIELDS carrid, connid,
         CASE WHEN seatsocc * 100 / seatsmax >= 90 THEN 'HAMPIR PENUH'
              ELSE 'MASIH ADA' END AS status,
         seatsmax - seatsocc AS sisa_kursi,
         concat_with_space( cityfrom, cityto, 1 ) AS rute,
         CAST( price AS abap.dec( 15, 0 ) ) AS harga,
         dats_add_days( fldate, 7 ) AS minggu_depan
  WHERE carrid IN ( SELECT carrid FROM zcarrier WHERE currcode = 'IDR' )
  ORDER BY carrid, connid
  INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flight).
cl_demo_output=>display( lt_flight ).

* 2. WITH (common table expression) + JOIN + COUNT( DISTINCT )
WITH +rekap AS (
  SELECT carrid, COUNT( DISTINCT cityfrom ) AS kota_asal, SUM( seatsocc ) AS penumpang
    FROM zflight GROUP BY carrid )
  SELECT r~carrid, c~carrname, r~kota_asal, r~penumpang
  FROM +rekap AS r INNER JOIN zcarrier AS c ON c~carrid = r~carrid
  ORDER BY penumpang DESCENDING
  INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_rekap).
cl_demo_output=>display( lt_rekap ).

* 3. UNION: semua kota yang dilayani (asal maupun tujuan)
SELECT cityfrom AS kota FROM zflight
  UNION
  SELECT cityto AS kota FROM zflight
  ORDER BY kota
  INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_kota).
WRITE: / |Kota yang dilayani: { lines( lt_kota ) }|.

* 4. Maskapai tanpa penerbangan ke Medan (NOT EXISTS, subquery berkorelasi)
SELECT c~carrid, c~carrname FROM zcarrier AS c
  WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT carrid FROM zflight
                       WHERE carrid = c~carrid AND cityto = 'MEDAN' )
  INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_tanpa_medan).
LOOP AT lt_tanpa_medan INTO DATA(ls_c).
  WRITE: / 'Tanpa rute ke Medan:', ls_c-carrname.
ENDLOOP.

* 5. Internal table: LOOP AT ... GROUP BY dan LOOP AT GROUP
SKIP.
SELECT * FROM zflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all).
LOOP AT lt_all INTO DATA(ls_f)
     GROUP BY ( maskapai = ls_f-carrid jumlah = GROUP SIZE )
     ASCENDING INTO DATA(ls_grp).
  DATA(lv_isi) = 0.
  LOOP AT GROUP ls_grp INTO DATA(ls_member).
    lv_isi = lv_isi + ls_member-seatsocc.
  ENDLOOP.
  WRITE: / ls_grp-maskapai, ls_grp-jumlah, 'penerbangan,', lv_isi, 'penumpang'.
ENDLOOP.

* 6. FOR GROUPS + REDUCE, dan FILTER
DATA(lt_ringkas) = VALUE string_table(
  FOR GROUPS g OF r IN lt_all GROUP BY r-cityfrom ASCENDING
  ( |{ g }: { REDUCE i( INIT n = 0 FOR m IN GROUP g NEXT n = n + 1 ) } keberangkatan| ) ).
LOOP AT lt_ringkas INTO DATA(lv_baris).
  WRITE / lv_baris.
ENDLOOP.

DATA lt_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF zflight WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY carrid.
lt_sorted = lt_all.
DATA(lt_garuda) = FILTER #( lt_sorted WHERE carrid = 'GA' ).
WRITE: / |Penerbangan Garuda: { lines( lt_garuda ) }|.

* 7. Tanggal: selisih hari dan tanggal + n
DATA lv_hari_ini TYPE d VALUE '20261231'.
DATA(lv_besok) = CONV d( lv_hari_ini + 1 ).
DATA lv_berangkat TYPE d VALUE '20270115'.
WRITE: / |Besok: { lv_besok DATE = ISO }, sisa hari sampai berangkat: { lv_berangkat - lv_hari_ini }|.

title: ABAP lanjutan: enum, RETRY, RTTI & test double
code:
REPORT z_abap_lanjutan.
* ABAP lanjutan: enum, RETRY, exception dengan pesan T100, time stamp,
* tipe dinamis (RTTI) dan test double. Tekan F8 untuk menjalankan,
* lalu Test (Ctrl+F10) untuk unit test dengan cl_abap_testdouble.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM ty_status,
         baru,
         diproses,
         selesai,
       END OF ENUM ty_status.

CLASS zcx_saldo DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_dyn_msg.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcx_saldo IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE lif_kurs.
  METHODS get_kurs IMPORTING iv_mata_uang TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_kurs) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS lcl_kasir DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_kurs TYPE REF TO lif_kurs OPTIONAL.
    METHODS bayar IMPORTING iv_jumlah TYPE i RAISING zcx_saldo.
    METHODS ke_rupiah IMPORTING iv_jumlah TYPE i iv_mata_uang TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv) TYPE i.
    DATA mv_saldo TYPE i VALUE 50.
    DATA mv_status TYPE ty_status.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_kurs TYPE REF TO lif_kurs.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS lcl_kasir IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_kurs = io_kurs.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD bayar.
    mv_status = diproses.
    IF iv_jumlah > mv_saldo.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_saldo MESSAGE e002(znusa) WITH mv_saldo iv_jumlah.
    ENDIF.
    mv_saldo = mv_saldo - iv_jumlah.
    mv_status = selesai.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD ke_rupiah.
    rv = iv_jumlah * mo_kurs->get_kurs( iv_mata_uang ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

START-OF-SELECTION.
* 1. Enum dan RETRY: saldo ditambah lalu pembayaran diulang
  DATA(lo_kasir) = NEW lcl_kasir( ).
  WRITE: / 'Status awal:', lo_kasir->mv_status.
  TRY.
      lo_kasir->bayar( 120 ).
      WRITE: / 'Pembayaran berhasil, sisa saldo', lo_kasir->mv_saldo.
    CATCH zcx_saldo INTO DATA(lx_saldo).
      WRITE: / 'Gagal:', lx_saldo->get_text( ).
      lo_kasir->mv_saldo = lo_kasir->mv_saldo + 100.
      RETRY.
  ENDTRY.
  WRITE: / 'Status akhir:', lo_kasir->mv_status.

* 2. Time stamp: jam keberangkatan WIB dalam waktu Tokyo
  SKIP.
  DATA lv_ts TYPE timestamp.
  DATA lv_tgl TYPE d.
  DATA lv_jam TYPE t.
  CONVERT DATE '20261102' TIME '083000' INTO TIME STAMP lv_ts TIME ZONE 'UTC+7'.
  CONVERT TIME STAMP lv_ts TIME ZONE 'JAPAN' INTO DATE lv_tgl TIME lv_jam.
  WRITE: / |Berangkat 08:30 WIB = { lv_jam TIME = ISO } waktu Tokyo|.
  DATA(lv_tiba) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( tstmp = lv_ts secs = 7 * 3600 ).
  WRITE: / |Tiba (UTC): { lv_tiba TIMESTAMP = ISO }|.

* 3. RTTI dan tipe dinamis: membaca komponen struktur saat runtime
  SKIP.
  DATA ls_flight TYPE zflight.
  DATA(lo_struct) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ls_flight ) ).
  DATA(lt_comp) = lo_struct->components.
  WRITE: / |Struktur { lo_struct->get_relative_name( ) } punya { lines( lt_comp ) } kolom:|.
  LOOP AT lt_comp INTO DATA(ls_comp).
    WRITE: / ls_comp-name, ls_comp-type_kind.
  ENDLOOP.

  DATA lr_data TYPE REF TO data.
  DATA(lv_tabel) = `ZCARRIER`.
  CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF (lv_tabel).
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_any> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
  ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <lt_any>.
  SELECT * FROM zcarrier INTO TABLE @<lt_any>.
  LOOP AT <lt_any> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_row>).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRNAME' OF STRUCTURE <ls_row> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_nama>).
    WRITE: / 'Maskapai:', <lv_nama>.
  ENDLOOP.

CLASS ltc_kasir DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS kurs_dari_test_double FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS ltc_kasir IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD kurs_dari_test_double.
    DATA lo_kurs TYPE REF TO lif_kurs.
    lo_kurs ?= cl_abap_testdouble=>create( 'LIF_KURS' ).
    cl_abap_testdouble=>configure_call( lo_kurs )->returning( 16000 )->and_expect( )->is_called_once( ).
    lo_kurs->get_kurs( `USD` ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW lcl_kasir( lo_kurs ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->ke_rupiah( iv_jumlah = 3 iv_mata_uang = `USD` ) exp = 48000 ).
    cl_abap_testdouble=>verify_expectations( lo_kurs ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

title: Kompatibilitas: NEW, THROW, STEP, SUBMIT & memory
code: REPORT z_kompatibilitas. * Sintaks ABAP yang sering ditemui di sistem nyata: NEW ...->method( ), * CASE TYPE OF, THROW, LOOP ... STEP, LINES OF, paging dengan OFFSET, * fungsi string, ABAP memory dan SUBMIT. CLASS lcx_tidak_ada DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check. ENDCLASS. CLASS lcx_tidak_ada IMPLEMENTATION. ENDCLASS. CLASS lcl_app DEFINITION. PUBLIC SECTION. DATA mt_kota TYPE string_table. METHODS run. METHODS harga IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv) TYPE string. ENDCLASS. CLASS lcl_app IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD run. * 1. LOOP langsung pada atribut objek dan LOOP ... STEP mt_kota = VALUE #( ( `JAKARTA` ) ( `MEDAN` ) ( `DENPASAR` ) ( `SURABAYA` ) ( `BANDUNG` ) ). WRITE / 'Kota ganjil:'. LOOP AT me->mt_kota INTO DATA(lv_kota) STEP 2. WRITE lv_kota. ENDLOOP. WRITE / 'Dari belakang:'. LOOP AT mt_kota INTO lv_kota STEP -1. WRITE lv_kota. ENDLOOP. * 2. COND ... THROW dan CASE TYPE OF TRY. DATA(lv_ga) = harga( `GA` ). WRITE: / 'GA:', lv_ga. DATA(lv_xx) = harga( `XX` ). WRITE: / 'XX:', lv_xx. CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx). CASE TYPE OF lx. WHEN TYPE lcx_tidak_ada. WRITE: / 'Maskapai tidak ditemukan (lcx_tidak_ada)'. WHEN OTHERS. WRITE: / 'Error lain:', lx->get_text( ). ENDCASE. ENDTRY. ENDMETHOD. METHOD harga. SELECT SINGLE carrname FROM zcarrier WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid INTO @DATA(lv_nama). rv = COND #( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN lv_nama ELSE THROW lcx_tidak_ada( ) ). ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS. START-OF-SELECTION. NEW lcl_app( )->run( ). * 3. Paging: halaman ke-2, isi 2 baris per halaman SKIP. SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM zflight ORDER BY price DESCENDING INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_hal2) UP TO 2 ROWS OFFSET 2. WRITE / 'Harga termahal ke-3 dan ke-4:'. LOOP AT lt_hal2 INTO DATA(ls_f). WRITE: / ls_f-carrid, ls_f-connid, ls_f-price. ENDLOOP. * 4. APPEND LINES OF ... FROM ... TO DATA lt_semua TYPE string_table. lt_semua = VALUE #( ( `a` ) ( `b` ) ( `c` ) ( `d` ) ). DATA lt_tengah TYPE string_table. APPEND LINES OF lt_semua FROM 2 TO 3 TO lt_tengah. WRITE: / 'Baris 2-3:', concat_lines_of( table = lt_tengah sep = `,` ). * 5. Fungsi string WRITE: / substring_before( val = `budi@abapnusantara.com` sub = `@` ), substring_after( val = `budi@abapnusantara.com` sub = `@` ), from_mixed( val = `namaPelanggan` ), escape( val = `Halo` format = cl_abap_format=>e_html_text ), distance( val1 = `JAKARTA` val2 = `JAKARTE` ). * 6. ABAP memory dan SUBMIT program lain (db/zlaporan_kota.abap, tab Tabel di browser) SKIP. EXPORT judul = `Rute dari` TO MEMORY ID 'ZNUSA_LAPORAN'. SUBMIT zlaporan_kota WITH p_kota = 'JAKARTA' AND RETURN. IMPORT jumlah = DATA(lv_jumlah) FROM MEMORY ID 'ZNUSA_HASIL'. WRITE: / 'Program zlaporan_kota menemukan', lv_jumlah, 'rute'.

title: Regex, RANGE, SORTED & COLLECT
code:
REPORT z_string_tabel.

* SORTED / HASHED table, COLLECT, RANGE, FIND / REPLACE dengan regex
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order,
         kota  TYPE c LENGTH 12,
         total TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 2,
       END OF ty_order.

DATA lt_rekap TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_order WITH UNIQUE KEY kota.
DATA lt_log   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

lt_log = VALUE #( ( `2026-10-01 Jakarta 125000.50` )
                  ( `2026-10-02 Bandung 80000` )
                  ( `2026-10-02 Jakarta 99500` )
                  ( `catatan rusak tanpa angka` )
                  ( `2026-10-03 Surabaya 40000.25` ) ).

LOOP AT lt_log INTO DATA(lv_line).
  FIND REGEX '^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}) (\w+) ([\d.]+)$' IN lv_line
       SUBMATCHES DATA(lv_tgl) DATA(lv_kota) DATA(lv_nilai).
  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    WRITE / |Lewati: "{ lv_line }"|.
    CONTINUE.
  ENDIF.
  " COLLECT menjumlahkan total per kota (kunci tabel = kota)
  COLLECT VALUE ty_order( kota = to_upper( lv_kota ) total = lv_nilai ) INTO lt_rekap.
ENDLOOP.

WRITE / 'Total per kota (SORTED TABLE selalu urut):'.
LOOP AT lt_rekap INTO DATA(ls_rekap).
  WRITE: / ls_rekap-kota, ls_rekap-total.
ENDLOOP.

" RANGE dan IN, seperti SELECT-OPTIONS
DATA lr_kota TYPE RANGE OF ty_order-kota.
lr_kota = VALUE #( ( sign = 'I' option = 'CP' low = 'J*' )
                   ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'BANDUNG' ) ).
DATA(lv_pilih) = REDUCE ty_order-total( INIT s = 0
                                        FOR r IN lt_rekap WHERE ( kota IN lr_kota )
                                        NEXT s = s + r-total ).
WRITE / |Jakarta + Bandung: { lv_pilih }|.

" REPLACE dengan regex dan fungsi string
DATA(lv_tlp) = `0812-3456-7890`.
REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\D' IN lv_tlp WITH ``.
WRITE / |Nomor bersih: { lv_tlp }, { strlen( lv_tlp ) } digit|.
WRITE / |Format +62: { replace( val = lv_tlp regex = '^0' with = '+62' ) }|.
WRITE / |Email valid? { xsdbool( matches( val = `budi@abapnusantara.com` regex = '[\w.]+@[\w.]+\.\w+' ) ) }|.

" HASHED TABLE: akses cepat lewat kunci unik
DATA lt_kurs TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_order WITH UNIQUE KEY kota.
INSERT VALUE #( kota = 'USD' total = '16250.00' ) INTO TABLE lt_kurs.
INSERT VALUE #( kota = 'USD' total = '1' ) INTO TABLE lt_kurs.
WRITE / |Kunci USD dobel ditolak: sy-subrc = { sy-subrc }, kurs = { lt_kurs[ kota = 'USD' ]-total }|.

title: Unit test (abapGit)
code:
CLASS zcx_cart_error DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  INHERITING FROM cx_static_check
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_reason TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_reason TYPE string OPTIONAL
        previous  LIKE previous OPTIONAL.
    METHODS get_text REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_cart_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    super->constructor( previous = previous ).
    mv_reason = iv_reason.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_text.
    result = mv_reason.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
INTERFACE zif_priced
  PUBLIC.
  TYPES ty_amount TYPE p LENGTH 15 DECIMALS 2.
  METHODS total
    RETURNING VALUE(rv_total) TYPE ty_amount.
ENDINTERFACE.
"! Shopping cart with a simple tiered discount
CLASS zcl_cart DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_priced.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             sku   TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             qty   TYPE i,
             price TYPE zif_priced=>ty_amount,
           END OF ty_item,
           tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add
      IMPORTING
        iv_sku   TYPE csequence
        iv_qty   TYPE i
        iv_price TYPE zif_priced=>ty_amount
      RAISING
        zcx_cart_error.
    METHODS items
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_items) TYPE tt_items.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_items TYPE tt_items.
    METHODS discount_percent
      IMPORTING iv_gross          TYPE zif_priced=>ty_amount
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_percent) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cart IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add.
    IF iv_qty <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_cart_error
        EXPORTING iv_reason = |Jumlah untuk { iv_sku } harus lebih dari nol|.
    ENDIF.
    READ TABLE mt_items ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_item>) WITH KEY sku = iv_sku.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <ls_item>-qty = <ls_item>-qty + iv_qty.
    ELSE.
      APPEND VALUE #( sku = iv_sku qty = iv_qty price = iv_price ) TO mt_items.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD items.
    rt_items = mt_items.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_priced~total.
    DATA(lv_gross) = REDUCE zif_priced=>ty_amount(
      INIT s = 0
      FOR item IN mt_items
      NEXT s = s + item-qty * item-price ).
    rv_total = lv_gross - lv_gross * discount_percent( lv_gross ) / 100.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD discount_percent.
    rv_percent = COND #( WHEN iv_gross >= 1000000 THEN 10
                         WHEN iv_gross >= 500000  THEN 5
                         ELSE 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS ltcl_cart DEFINITION FINAL FOR TESTING
  DURATION SHORT
  RISK LEVEL HARMLESS.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_cut TYPE REF TO zcl_cart.
    METHODS setup.
    METHODS empty_cart_costs_nothing FOR TESTING.
    METHODS same_sku_is_merged FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS discount_from_500k FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS zero_qty_is_rejected FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_cart IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    mo_cut = NEW #( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD empty_cart_costs_nothing.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( mo_cut->zif_priced~total( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD same_sku_is_merged.
    mo_cut->add( iv_sku = 'KOPI' iv_qty = 2 iv_price = 25000 ).
    mo_cut->add( iv_sku = 'KOPI' iv_qty = 1 iv_price = 25000 ).
    DATA(lt_items) = mo_cut->items( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_items ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items[ 1 ]-qty exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD discount_from_500k.
    mo_cut->add( iv_sku = 'MESIN' iv_qty = 1 iv_price = 600000 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mo_cut->zif_priced~total( ) exp = 570000 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zero_qty_is_rejected.
    TRY.
        mo_cut->add( iv_sku = 'TEH' iv_qty = 0 iv_price = 10000 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'zcx_cart_error expected' ).
      CATCH zcx_cart_error INTO DATA(lx).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_char_cp( act = lx->get_text( ) exp = '*TEH*' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

START-OF-SELECTION.
  " Tekan "Tes" untuk menjalankan ABAP Unit, atau "Jalankan" untuk demo ini
  DATA(lo_cart) = NEW zcl_cart( ).
  lo_cart->add( iv_sku = 'KOPI' iv_qty = 2 iv_price = 45000 ).
  lo_cart->add( iv_sku = 'MESIN' iv_qty = 1 iv_price = 600000 ).
  cl_demo_output=>display( lo_cart->items( ) ).
  WRITE / |Total setelah diskon: { lo_cart->zif_priced~total( ) }|.

REPORT z_itab.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_customer,
         id     TYPE n LENGTH 4,
         name   TYPE string,
         city   TYPE c LENGTH 20,
         points TYPE i,
       END OF ty_customer,
       tt_customer TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_customer WITH EMPTY KEY.

DATA lt_customers TYPE tt_customer.
DATA ls_customer  TYPE ty_customer.

lt_customers = VALUE #(
  ( id = 1 name = 'Andi'  city = 'Jakarta'  points = 120 )
  ( id = 2 name = 'Budi'  city = 'Bandung'  points = 80 )
  ( id = 3 name = 'Citra' city = 'Surabaya' points = 200 )
).

ls_customer-id     = 4.
ls_customer-name   = 'Dewi'.
ls_customer-city   = 'Jakarta'.
ls_customer-points = 150.
APPEND ls_customer TO lt_customers.

SORT lt_customers BY points DESCENDING.

WRITE / 'Pelanggan berdasarkan poin:'.
LOOP AT lt_customers INTO DATA(ls_row).
  WRITE: / sy-tabix, ls_row-id, ls_row-name, ls_row-city, ls_row-points.
ENDLOOP.

READ TABLE lt_customers INTO ls_customer WITH KEY name = 'Budi'.
IF sy-subrc = 0.
  WRITE / |Ketemu: { ls_customer-name } dari { ls_customer-city }, baris { sy-tabix }|.
ENDIF.

DATA(lv_total) = 0.
LOOP AT lt_customers INTO ls_customer WHERE city = 'Jakarta'.
  lv_total = lv_total + ls_customer-points.
ENDLOOP.
WRITE / |Total poin pelanggan Jakarta: { lv_total }|.

" Bonus 10% for everyone, written back with MODIFY
LOOP AT lt_customers INTO ls_customer.
  ls_customer-points = ls_customer-points * 110 / 100.
  MODIFY lt_customers FROM ls_customer.
ENDLOOP.

WRITE / |Peringkat 1: { lt_customers[ 1 ]-name }, jumlah pelanggan: { lines( lt_customers ) }|.
SKIP.

cl_demo_output=>display( lt_customers ).

REPORT z_hello.

* Classic WRITE output and modern string templates
DATA lv_name  TYPE string VALUE 'Dunia'.
DATA lv_count TYPE i.

WRITE: / 'Halo dari ABAP lokal!',
       / |Selamat datang, { lv_name }!|.

DO 5 TIMES.
  lv_count = lv_count + sy-index.
ENDDO.
WRITE / |Jumlah 1 sampai 5 = { lv_count }|.

" Integer division rounds, just like on a real system: 15 / 4 = 4
DATA(lv_avg) = lv_count / 4.
WRITE / |15 / 4 dalam tipe I = { lv_avg }|.

DATA lv_price TYPE p DECIMALS 2 VALUE '1250000.50'.
lv_price = lv_price * 2.
WRITE / |Harga x2 = { lv_price }|.

DATA lv_date TYPE d.
lv_date = sy-datum.
IF lv_count > 10 AND lv_name IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_date IS NOT INITIAL.
  WRITE / 'Kondisi IF berjalan.'.
ELSE.
  WRITE / 'Tidak akan tampil.'.
ENDIF.

title: FORM & string
code:
REPORT z_forms.

DATA lv_result TYPE i.
DATA lv_text   TYPE string VALUE '  belajar   abap   di   laptop  '.

PERFORM add_numbers USING 7 35 CHANGING lv_result.
WRITE / |7 + 35 = { lv_result }|.

lv_text = condense( lv_text ).
WRITE / |condense : "{ lv_text }"|.
WRITE / |to_upper : { to_upper( lv_text ) }|.
WRITE / |strlen   : { strlen( lv_text ) }|.

DATA lt_words TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
SPLIT lv_text AT ` ` INTO TABLE lt_words.
WRITE / |kata     : { lines( lt_words ) } -> { concat_lines_of( table = lt_words sep = ` | ` ) }|.

DATA lv_grade TYPE c LENGTH 1.
DO 3 TIMES.
  CASE sy-index.
    WHEN 1. lv_grade = 'A'.
    WHEN 2. lv_grade = 'B'.
    WHEN OTHERS. lv_grade = 'C'.
  ENDCASE.
  WRITE: / 'Iterasi', sy-index, 'nilai', lv_grade.
ENDDO.

DATA(lv_n) = 10.
DATA(lv_fact) = 1.
WHILE lv_n > 1.
  lv_fact = lv_fact * lv_n.
  lv_n -= 1.
ENDWHILE.
WRITE / |10! = { lv_fact }|.

PERFORM fizzbuzz USING 15.

FORM add_numbers USING iv_a TYPE i
                       iv_b TYPE i
                 CHANGING cv_sum TYPE i.
  cv_sum = iv_a + iv_b.
ENDFORM.

FORM fizzbuzz USING iv_max TYPE i.
  DATA lv_line TYPE string.
  DO iv_max TIMES.
    IF sy-index MOD 15 = 0.
      lv_line = lv_line && ` FizzBuzz`.
    ELSEIF sy-index MOD 3 = 0.
      lv_line = lv_line && ` Fizz`.
    ELSEIF sy-index MOD 5 = 0.
      lv_line = lv_line && ` Buzz`.
    ELSE.
      lv_line = |{ lv_line } { sy-index }|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDDO.
  WRITE / |FizzBuzz:{ lv_line }|.
ENDFORM.
